metadata.description: Claude Code plugins for LLM-first development workflows

plugins.name: llm-friendliness-review
plugins.description: Audit your codebase for LLM-friendliness. Run after major changes, when confused by code, or periodically.

plugins.name: skill-stats
plugins.description: Track Claude Code usage by skill invocation with real-time LiteLLM pricing. Shows tokens, costs, and nested skill attribution.

plugins.name: harness-engineering
plugins.description: Make repositories work as operating systems for AI agents. Audit agent-readiness, apply harness elements, or bootstrap L2 maturity.

plugins.name: project-documentation
plugins.description: Post-task documentation checklist. Keeps docs current after code/infra changes. Detects project type and runs appropriate checklist.

plugins.name: fact-check
plugins.description: Multi-agent fact verification for legal and financial documents. Extracts claims, verifies against web sources, cross-checks, and produces patched documents with citations.
